14.text: Black and polar bears are also supposed to have households. Black

15.text: bears live in underground houses, and polar bears have a country of their

16.text: own on the ice in the open sea. They live by hunting seal and walrus, and

17.text: engage in quite extended expeditions for this purpose. They also build snow

18.text: houses, which are lighted by oil-lamps, and have other human-like pursuits.

22.text: The smallest birds also have a country of their own, from which they

24.text: Sea-mammals have a large country of their own far away in the open sea.

25.text: It is located on both sides of the earth, and is separated from the land by a

26.text: long narrow strip of water, which, they say, constantly “quakes like a bottom-

27.text: less mire.” This is impassable for all beings that come from the land.

28.text: Animals, when personating human beings, can change their shape and

29.text: size quite as easily as spirits do. The ermine, for example, appears as a stately

30.text: warrior clad in white armor, while the legs of mice he has killed turn into

31.text: reindeer-hams. The owl, also, becomes a warrior. Mice are people living in

32.text: underground houses, who use the root of Polygonum viviparum or Polygonum

33.text: polymorphum as their reindeer, and have sledges of grass. By a sudden

34.text: transformation they become real hunters with regular sledges, and hunt polar

35.text: bears. When they want to carry the dead bear home, the sledge returns to
